'''Lily''' (Japanese: '''リリー''' ''Lily'') is a magician who appeared as a [[character of the day]] in ''[[EP241|Hocus Pokémon]]''. She also appeared in the [[Ash & Pikachu]] {{pkmn|manga}}.

==In animation==
Lily recruited {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to search for the ingredients she needed for a spell that would let humans understand the speech of Pokémon. Her ancient spell book is a family heirloom passed down for hundreds of years. Lily is able to read the ancient script inside her book which dates back to the third King of Pokémania. However, when she actually got to perform that spell, she accidentally [[Human–Pokémon transformation|transformed]] Ash into [[Ashachu|a Pikachu]]. Ash wasn't too concerned after learning that the magic was only temporary, and he returned to his human form in ''[[EP242|As Clear as Crystal]]''.

In the [[dub]], Lily speaks with a Cockney accent.

|desc={{p|Murkrow}} is Lily's only known Pokémon. It helped Lily with her spells and was mostly seen sitting on her shoulder. It first appeared when it found {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} so that Lily could use {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Thunderbolt}} in a spell. Murkrow helped Ash blow away {{p|Parasect}}'s {{m|Sleep Powder}} before {{TRT}}'s attack. Team Rocket stole Pikachu, but were blasted off when Murkrow pecked a hole in their [[Team Rocket's mechas|balloon]].

Later, Team Rocket stole Lily's spell book. Murkrow tried to stop them again but was knocked out. When Team Rocket was found, Murkrow defeated {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Weezing}} to send them blasting off once again.

Murkrow's known moves are {{m|Icy Wind}} and {{m|Swift}}.}}
